arguments.script:
# Check what package manager is available
if command -v apt-get &> /dev/null; then
    echo "=== Debian/Ubuntu system detected ==="
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc make
elif command -v yum &> /dev/null; then
    echo "=== RedHat/CentOS system detected ==="
    yum install -y gcc make
elif command -v apk &> /dev/null; then
    echo "=== Alpine system detected ==="
    apk add --no-cache gcc make musl-dev
else
    echo "=== Unknown package manager ==="
    exit 1
fi

# Verify gcc is now available
which gcc
gcc --version

    echo "=== Alpine system detected ==="
    apk add --no-cache gcc make musl-dev

    exit 1
fi

# Verify gcc is now available
which gcc
gcc --version
